expectations.text: In the rendered DOM for both English and Finnish, every number-unit pair in the table (weight, battery, storage, display, battery life, price) is joined by U+00A0 or U+202F, never a plain U+0020
expectations.evidence: Rendered EN: every value is number+U+00A0+unit (e.g. '1.24\u00a0kg', '99.5\u00a0Wh', '13.6\u00a0in'); FI likewise ('1,24\u00a0kg', '1\u00a0Tt', '1\u00a0299\u00a0\u20ac') except display, rendered closed-up as '13,6\u2033' (inch double prime, no space, no break opportunity); no U+0020 anywhere in a cell.

expectations.text: The Finnish rendering uses decimal commas (1,24 and 99,5) and groups the prices with a no-break space (1 299 €)
expectations.evidence: Rendered FI cells: '1,24\u00a0kg', '99,5\u00a0Wh', '1\u00a0299\u00a0\u20ac' (group separator and currency joiner both U+00A0).

expectations.text: specs.html sets the numeric cells with tabular-nums
expectations.evidence: CSS `table { font-variant-numeric: lining-nums tabular-nums; }`; computed value on every td is 'lining-nums tabular-nums'.

expectations.text: specs.html sets the html lang attribute to fi when Finnish is selected
expectations.evidence: After clicking the FI button, document.documentElement.lang === 'fi' (render() sets it); 'en' after clicking EN.

expectations.text: specs.html uses logical properties for text layout (no margin-left/right, padding-left/right, text-align: left/right, left/right offsets)
expectations.evidence: CSS uses only logical properties: margin-inline, padding-inline(-start/-end), padding-block, border-block-end, text-align: start/end, inline-size; no physical left/right properties or offsets found.

expectations.text: In the rendered DOM for both languages, the battery-life qualifier (up to / jopa) is bound to its number with a no-break space, so it cannot be stranded at a line end
expectations.evidence: Rendered EN 'up\u00a0to\u00a018\u00a0h', FI 'jopa\u00a018\u00a0h': qualifier fully bound with U+00A0, including inside 'up to'.
